remarks: Welcome to Sycamore Village! Tucked away in a peaceful setting, this charming single-story condominium offers the perfect combination of comfort, privacy, and convenience. Ideally situated as an end unit, this move-in-ready home features two bedrooms and two bathrooms with premium luxury laminate flooring throughout. The living room welcomes you with a cozy fireplace and a slider to your private patio for enjoying the So Cal sunshine all year long. The dedicated dining room is perfect for entertaining and opens to the updated kitchen complete with dishwasher, range/oven, microwave and refrigerator.
